_about: Stubs: parts A9 has defined (layer, faces, attach points, price) and not built. `kind` is 'stub', so a stub can't be picked from the Build list and says 'Not built yet.' when placed by hand. The track named in `track` fills one in by giving it a real kind and behaviour and dropping `stub` and `track`. Prices are placeholders until A10. See logistics.json for the format. Standalone tools stand on a line (a Pipe, Cable or Network) where it meets their centre.

modules.name: Area Vac
modules.blurb: A tool that stands on a line and draws the loose pixels of an area into it.

modules.name: Scoop
modules.blurb: A tool that stands on a line and lifts a measured scoop of powder or liquid out of what is under it.

modules.name: Grabber
modules.blurb: A tool that stands on a line and picks up loose rigid bodies and sets them down.

modules.name: Floodlight
modules.blurb: Replaces the Lamp: lights a wide area for a little power.
